provenance_note: Official response of the National Diet Library's Diet minutes API (JSON, UTF-8), served with Cache-Control: no-cache, no-store; the JSON carries no timestamp, session token or request echo, so it is not generated per request. Researcher (the integrator): downloaded on 28 September 2026 (UTC) at 15:01:19Z (plain); 15:01:21Z (cache-busting query); 15:31:57Z (plain), each time with the same byte count and SHA-256. Downloaded on 28 September 2026 (UTC) by this packet at 15:37:40Z and 16:13:14Z, 35 minutes apart, and at 16:14:15Z (cache-busting query), each time with the same byte count and SHA-256; at least two downloads were 30 minutes or more apart. Bytes and SHA-256 are of the identity-encoded body, requested without Accept-Encoding (the Diet API and the Internet Archive send gzip when a client asks for it, which changes the transferred bytes but not the content). This checked-in file is a derived factual extract, not a copy of the original response. Original response bodies, images and page renders are not checked into this repository. Its own checksum is recorded separately in the packet.
rights_note: Factual observations paraphrased with attribution; short quotations only. No photographs, emblems, seals, signatures, scanned pages or long speech text copied. No open license, portrait permission or likeness approval is asserted.
scope_note: The Diet minutes API's JSON for the whole meeting record of the 衆議院 予算委員会 第5号 (1990-04-06), a transcription of the House's printed minutes; the exact API URL whose bytes were hashed is recorded, and the readable minutes page is https://kokkai.ndl.go.jp/txt/111805261X00519900406. The printed page images, served through a JavaScript viewer, were not viewed. Statements are used only where a party officer speaks of the party office. Recorded at meeting level because the party-officer identification and the statement are in different speeches.

rows.role_title: 委員長 / 党首 — chair of the Japan Socialist Party and, from its 1996 renaming, the Social Democratic Party
rows.text: In the House of Representatives Budget Committee on 6 April 1990, 山口鶴男, whom the same record identifies as the party's secretary-general (his own account of a 書記長・幹事長会談 with 小沢幹事長 in speech 5, and the Prime Minister's reply to '山口書記長' in speech 6), says of the party's policy that '土井委員長はかねがね強調いたしておられます' (speech 74): a party officer's same-day statement naming 土井 as chair.

locator.speaker: 山口鶴男 (5, 74); 海部俊樹 (6, identifies him as 山口書記長)

bounded_scope: Party-office observations of the chair of 日本社会党 (委員長) and, from the January 1996 renaming, the party leader of 社会民主党 (党首), for CLAUDE-C01-29 only, 1990-2026. Party elections and selections, notices, filings, counts and declarations, convention approvals, statements of assumption, in-office attestations, announced, submitted, accepted and withdrawn resignations, stated ends, acting arrangements, predecessor references, the renaming, the 2020 convention decision and retrospective records stay separate rows; holder boundaries are decided in the packet, not by any row. A null holder_name means the source names no holder of this office (a notice, a schedule, a filing by several candidates, an organization event, an acting leader). The prime-ministership (jp_pm), ministerial and Speaker offices, parliamentary groups and other party offices are excluded: no row feeds them, and none of their claims feeds this office. Organization identities stay unresolved; no row maps or merges 日本社会党, 社会民主党 or any other party.
